metadata.description: Disease solutions including treatments, prevention, and consultation guidelines

diseases.name: Flu
diseases.primary_treatment: Rest, hydration, antiviral medications (oseltamivir) within 48 hours, fever reducers (acetaminophen/ibuprofen)
diseases.prevention_tips: Annual flu vaccination, frequent hand washing, avoid close contact with sick individuals, cover mouth when coughing/sneezing
diseases.when_to_consult: High fever >3 days, difficulty breathing, chest pain, severe weakness, confusion, dehydration signs
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Tulsi (holy basil) tea, ginger-honey mixture, turmeric in warm milk, steam inhalation with eucalyptus oil, Giloy (Tinospora cordifolia) extract

diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.primary_treatment: Symptomatic relief - decongestants, antihistamines, nasal saline irrigation, throat lozenges, warm fluids
diseases.prevention_tips: Hand hygiene, avoid touching face, disinfect surfaces, maintain distance from infected persons
diseases.when_to_consult: Symptoms persist >10 days, high fever, severe sinus pain, breathing difficulties
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ginger tea with honey, licorice root (mulethi), steam inhalation, warm water with lemon and honey, cinnamon tea

diseases.name: Viral Fever
diseases.primary_treatment: Symptomatic treatment - antipyretics, hydration, rest. Antivirals if specific virus identified
diseases.prevention_tips: Vaccination (where available), vector control, food hygiene, avoid contact with infected individuals
diseases.when_to_consult: Fever >103F, fever lasting >3 days, rash with fever, severe headache with fever
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Coriander seed water, fenugreek seeds tea, tulsi leaves, neem extract, papaya leaf extract for dengue

diseases.name: Pneumonia
diseases.primary_treatment: Antibiotics (bacterial), antiviral medications (viral), hospitalization for severe cases, oxygen therapy if needed
diseases.prevention_tips: Pneumococcal vaccination, flu vaccination, smoking cessation, good hand hygiene, manage chronic conditions
diseases.when_to_consult: Immediately - difficulty breathing, chest pain, high fever with chills, confusion, bluish lips/nails
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Adjuvant therapy only - tulsi, black pepper, honey, steam inhalation. Medical treatment essential

diseases.name: Throat Infection
diseases.primary_treatment: Antibiotics if bacterial (strep throat), antiviral if viral, warm salt water gargles, throat sprays, pain relievers
diseases.prevention_tips: Don't share utensils, hand washing, avoid close contact with infected persons, replace toothbrush after illness
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe sore throat >48 hours, difficulty swallowing, fever >101F, white patches on tonsils
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Yashtimadhu (licorice) gargle, turmeric milk, ginger tea, honey with black pepper, tulsi leaves

diseases.name: Cold / Allergies
diseases.primary_treatment: Antihistamines for allergies, decongestants, nasal corticosteroid sprays, immunotherapy for chronic allergies
diseases.prevention_tips: Identify and avoid allergens, use air purifiers, wash bedding regularly, keep pets clean, monitor pollen counts
diseases.when_to_consult: Symptoms interfere with daily life, breathing difficulties, symptoms year-round, OTC medications ineffective
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Nasya (nasal oil drops), trikatu powder, amla (Indian gooseberry), haritaki, steam with ajwain (carom seeds)

diseases.name: Acidity / Gas
diseases.primary_treatment: Antacids, H2 blockers, proton pump inhibitors, dietary modifications, avoid trigger foods
diseases.prevention_tips: Eat smaller meals, avoid spicy/fatty foods, don't lie down after eating, reduce caffeine/alcohol, manage stress
diseases.when_to_consult: Frequent heartburn >2 times/week, difficulty swallowing, weight loss, blood in vomit/stool
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ajwain (carom seeds) with salt, fennel seeds after meals, licorice root, aloe vera juice, buttermilk with spices

diseases.name: Breathing Problem
diseases.primary_treatment: Bronchodilators, inhaled corticosteroids, oxygen therapy, pulmonary rehabilitation, treat underlying cause
diseases.prevention_tips: Quit smoking, avoid air pollution, regular exercise, vaccinations (flu/pneumonia), maintain healthy weight
diseases.when_to_consult: Immediately - severe shortness of breath, blue lips/fingertips, inability to speak, rapid breathing
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Vasa (Adhatoda vasica), tulsi, pippali (long pepper), yashtimadhu, steam inhalation. Medical care primary

diseases.name: Stomach Upset
diseases.primary_treatment: Antiemetics, antacids, fluid replacement, BRAT diet (bananas, rice, applesauce, toast), probiotics
diseases.prevention_tips: Food hygiene, cook meat thoroughly, wash fruits/vegetables, drink clean water, avoid expired foods
diseases.when_to_consult: Vomiting >24 hours, blood in vomit/stool, severe abdominal pain, dehydration signs, high fever
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ginger tea, peppermint tea, chamomile tea, cumin water, rice water, probiotic buttermilk

diseases.name: Food Poisoning
diseases.primary_treatment: Fluid replacement (oral rehydration solution), rest, antibiotics if bacterial cause identified, antiemetics
diseases.prevention_tips: Proper food handling, cook to safe temperatures, refrigerate promptly, separate raw/cooked foods, hand washing
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe dehydration, bloody stools/vomit, high fever >101.5F, neurologic symptoms (blurred vision, weakness)
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Jeera (cumin) water, coriander seed water, ginger juice, honey with lemon, oral rehydration with natural salts

diseases.name: Loose Motion
diseases.primary_treatment: Oral rehydration therapy, antidiarrheals (loperamide), probiotics, zinc supplements, identify and treat cause
diseases.prevention_tips: Hand hygiene, safe drinking water, proper sanitation, food safety, vaccination (rotavirus)
diseases.when_to_consult: Diarrhea >2 days, bloody/mucoid stools, high fever, severe dehydration, abdominal pain
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Pomegranate juice/rind, buttermilk with roasted cumin, rice water, nutmeg powder, haritaki

diseases.name: Stomach Pain
diseases.primary_treatment: Depends on cause - antacids, antibiotics, antispasmodics, dietary changes, surgery if appendicitis
diseases.prevention_tips: Balanced diet, regular meals, stress management, avoid trigger foods, stay hydrated, exercise regularly
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe pain, pain lasting >24 hours, fever, vomiting blood, black stools, inability to pass stool/gas
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ginger, fennel, ajwain, asafoetida (hing), peppermint, warm compress, castor oil pack

diseases.name: Muscle Strain
diseases.primary_treatment: RICE (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation), NSAIDs, muscle relaxants, physical therapy, heat therapy after 48 hours
diseases.prevention_tips: Warm up before exercise, proper lifting techniques, ergonomic workspace, regular stretching, strengthen core muscles
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe pain, inability to move, numbness/tingling, pain persists >1 week, signs of infection
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Mahamasha taila (warm sesame oil), nirgundi oil, turmeric paste, ginger compress, ashwagandha

diseases.name: Body Pain
diseases.primary_treatment: Analgesics, NSAIDs, rest, hydration, heat/cold therapy, massage, identify and treat underlying cause
diseases.prevention_tips: Regular exercise, proper posture, ergonomic setup, stress management, adequate sleep, hydration
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe/unexplained pain, fever with pain, weakness/numbness, pain after injury, weight loss
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Abhyanga (full body massage with medicated oils), ginger-turmeric, epsom salt baths, yoga, ashwagandha

diseases.name: Body Ache
diseases.primary_treatment: Similar to body pain - analgesics, rest, hydration, treat underlying cause
diseases.prevention_tips: Regular exercise, balanced diet, adequate sleep, stress reduction, proper ergonomics
diseases.when_to_consult: Persistent pain, severe pain, fever, rashes, joint swelling, neurological symptoms
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Castor oil, ginger, turmeric, boswellia (shallaki), guggulu, warm oil massage

diseases.name: Weakness / Tiredness
diseases.primary_treatment: Identify and treat underlying cause, iron supplements if anemic, B12 if deficient, rest, balanced diet
diseases.prevention_tips: Balanced diet, regular exercise, adequate sleep, stress management, regular health checkups
diseases.when_to_consult: Persistent weakness >2 weeks, severe fatigue affecting daily life, unexplained weight loss, fainting
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ashwagandha, shatavari, chyawanprash, amla, dates, almonds, ghee in moderation

diseases.name: Low BP / Weakness
diseases.primary_treatment: Increased fluid/salt intake, compression stockings, medications (fludrocortisone, midodrine) if chronic, treat underlying cause
diseases.prevention_tips: Stay hydrated, rise slowly from sitting/lying, small frequent meals, avoid alcohol, compression garments
diseases.when_to_consult: Frequent fainting, severe dizziness, chest pain, confusion, rapid/irregular heartbeat
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Licorice (mulethi), ashwagandha, amla, pomegranate juice, raisins soaked overnight, tulsi

diseases.name: Skin Allergy
diseases.primary_treatment: Antihistamines, topical corticosteroids, moisturizers, avoid allergens, phototherapy for chronic cases
diseases.prevention_tips: Identify and avoid triggers, patch testing, hypoallergenic products, wear protective clothing
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe reaction, difficulty breathing, widespread rash, infection signs, OTC treatments ineffective
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Neem paste, aloe vera, manjistha, khadirarishta, haridra khanda, avoid incompatible food combinations

diseases.name: Allergy
diseases.primary_treatment: Antihistamines, nasal corticosteroids, decongestants, immunotherapy (allergy shots), epinephrine for anaphylaxis
diseases.prevention_tips: Allergen avoidance, HEPA filters, regular cleaning, immunotherapy, emergency action plan
diseases.when_to_consult: Anaphylaxis, severe reactions, symptoms uncontrolled with OTC meds, affecting quality of life
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Trikatu, vasa, yashtimadhu, amla, haritaki, nasya therapy, avoid incompatible foods

diseases.name: Inflammation
diseases.primary_treatment: NSAIDs, corticosteroids, rest, ice, compression, elevation, treat underlying inflammatory condition
diseases.prevention_tips: Anti-inflammatory diet, regular exercise, stress management, avoid injury, omega-3 supplements
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe swelling, redness, warmth, fever, inability to use affected area, sudden swelling
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Turmeric, ginger, boswellia, guggulu, castor oil, warm fomentation

diseases.name: Eye Strain
diseases.primary_treatment: Rest eyes, 20-20-20 rule, proper lighting, corrective lenses if needed, lubricating eye drops
diseases.prevention_tips: Regular breaks from screens, proper ergonomics, adequate lighting, correct prescription, eye exercises
diseases.when_to_consult: Vision changes, severe pain, persistent symptoms, double vision, flashes/floaters
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Triphala eye wash, ghee (clarified butter) in diet, amla, rose water drops, palming technique, netra tarpana

diseases.name: Ear Blockage
diseases.primary_treatment: Ear drops, irrigation, antibiotics if infection, decongestants, avoid Q-tips, treat underlying cause
diseases.prevention_tips: Keep ears dry, don't insert objects, treat allergies promptly, avoid swimming in contaminated water
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe pain, discharge from ear, sudden hearing loss, dizziness, fever with ear pain
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Bilva oil, garlic oil (warm), onion juice drops (diluted), avoid water entry, karnapurana therapy

diseases.name: Sleep Problem
diseases.primary_treatment: Sleep hygiene, CBT-I, melatonin, sedatives if prescribed, treat underlying conditions, relaxation techniques
diseases.prevention_tips: Regular sleep schedule, avoid caffeine/alcohol before bed, dark/quiet/cool room, no screens before bed, exercise regularly
diseases.when_to_consult: Insomnia >3 weeks, excessive daytime sleepiness, snoring/gasping, abnormal movements during sleep
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Warm milk with nutmeg/cardamom, ashwagandha, brahmi, shankhpushpi, abhyanga, meditation

diseases.name: Stress
diseases.primary_treatment: Counseling, CBT, stress management techniques, medications if needed (anxiolytics/antidepressants), lifestyle modifications
diseases.prevention_tips: Regular exercise, meditation, time management, healthy boundaries, social support, hobbies, adequate sleep
diseases.when_to_consult: Stress affecting daily functioning, panic attacks, persistent anxiety/depression, substance use to cope
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ashwagandha, brahmi, shankhpushpi, jatamansi, meditation, yoga, pranayama, abhyanga

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.primary_treatment: Triptans, NSAIDs, antiemetics, preventive medications (beta blockers, anticonvulsants), Botox for chronic cases
diseases.prevention_tips: Identify and avoid triggers, regular sleep/eating, hydration, stress management, exercise, keep headache diary
diseases.when_to_consult: Frequent/severe migraines, pattern changes, neurological deficits, first migraine after age 50, medication overuse
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Shirashooladi vati, godanti bhasma, pippali, saffron, sandalwood paste on forehead, nasya with anu taila

diseases.name: Asthma / Allergy
diseases.primary_treatment: Bronchodilators (salbutamol), inhaled corticosteroids, antihistamines, leukotriene modifiers, allergen avoidance, immunotherapy for allergies
diseases.prevention_tips: Avoid known allergens and triggers, use air purifiers, asthma action plan, flu and pneumococcal vaccinations, maintain healthy weight, regular exercise
diseases.when_to_consult: Worsening symptoms despite rescue inhaler, frequent night symptoms, difficulty speaking, blue lips/fingertips, ER for severe asthma attack
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Vasa (Adhatoda vasica), tulsi, pippali (long pepper), yashtimadhu (licorice), steam inhalation, nasya therapy, avoid cold and damp foods

diseases.name: Mental Stress
diseases.primary_treatment: Psychological counseling, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), mindfulness meditation, relaxation techniques, lifestyle adjustments, medications (antidepressants/anxiolytics) if indicated
diseases.prevention_tips: Regular physical activity, meditation, time management, healthy work-life balance, adequate sleep, balanced nutrition, social connections, hobbies
diseases.when_to_consult: Stress interfering with daily functioning, panic attacks, persistent anxiety or depression, substance misuse, thoughts of self-harm
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Ashwagandha, brahmi, shankhpushpi, jatamansi, meditation, yoga, pranayama, abhyanga (body massage), calming herbal teas

diseases.name: Tension Headache
diseases.primary_treatment: Over-the-counter pain relievers (NSAIDs, acetaminophen), rest, stress reduction, massage, applying heat or cold packs, improving posture
diseases.prevention_tips: Stress management, regular sleep schedule, staying hydrated, ergonomic workstation, limit screen time, regular exercise, manage anxiety
diseases.when_to_consult: Headaches more than 15 days per month, severe intensity, medication overuse, neurological symptoms (vision changes, weakness), headache after head injury
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Brahmi, shankhpushpi, ashwagandha, ginger paste, nasya therapy with anu taila, shirodhara, meditation, yoga

diseases.name: COVID-19
diseases.primary_treatment: Rest, hydration, antipyretics for fever, monitoring oxygen levels, antiviral medications (remdesivir) for severe cases
diseases.prevention_tips: Vaccination, mask wearing in crowded places, hand hygiene, social distancing, improve ventilation
diseases.when_to_consult: Difficulty breathing, persistent chest pain, confusion, inability to wake up, bluish lips/nails
diseases.recommended_specialist: Pulmonologist, Infectious Disease Specialist, General Physician
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Tulsi tea, ginger, turmeric, ashwagandha, steam inhalation. Medical care primary for confirmed cases

diseases.name: Dengue Fever
diseases.primary_treatment: Supportive care - hydration, pain relievers (avoid aspirin), blood transfusion if severe, monitor platelet count
diseases.prevention_tips: Eliminate standing water, use mosquito repellent, wear long sleeves, sleep under net, control vector population
diseases.when_to_consult: Severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding gums, easy bruising, difficulty breathing
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Papaya leaf extract, tulsi, ginger, coriander, fluids. Medical care essential - dengue can be fatal

diseases.name: Malaria
diseases.primary_treatment: Antimalarial drugs (artemisinin-based combination therapy), hydration, antipyretics for fever
diseases.prevention_tips: Use insecticide-treated bed nets, antimalarial prophylaxis when traveling, eliminate standing water, mosquito repellent
diseases.when_to_consult: High fever with chills, severe anemia symptoms, confusion, difficulty breathing, seizures
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Tulsi, neem, aloe vera, goldenseal. Medical treatment essential - malaria is life-threatening

diseases.name: Meningitis
diseases.primary_treatment: Antibiotics for bacterial meningitis, antiviral medications for viral, corticosteroids for inflammation
diseases.prevention_tips: Vaccination (meningococcal, pneumococcal), avoid sharing utensils, good hand hygiene
diseases.when_to_consult: Immediately - severe headache, neck stiffness, fever, confusion, light sensitivity, rash
diseases.recommended_specialist: Neurologist, Infectious Disease Specialist, Emergency Medicine
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Tulsi, ginger, turmeric. Emergency medical care critical - meningitis can be fatal

diseases.name: Heart Attack
diseases.primary_treatment: Emergency - aspirin, nitroglycerin, oxygen, cardiac catheterization, thrombolytics, PCI
diseases.prevention_tips: Healthy diet, regular exercise, quit smoking, manage stress, control cholesterol/blood pressure/diabetes
diseases.when_to_consult: IMMEDIATELY - chest pain/pressure, shortness of breath, arm/jaw pain, nausea, cold sweat
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Arjun chaal, garlic, hawthorn berry. Call emergency services first - ayurveda adjuvant only

diseases.name: Stroke
diseases.primary_treatment: Emergency - tPA for ischemic stroke, mechanical thrombectomy, blood pressure management
diseases.prevention_tips: Control blood pressure, quit smoking, manage diabetes, healthy diet, exercise regularly
diseases.when_to_consult: IMMEDIATELY - face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty, sudden severe headache, vision loss
diseases.ayurvedic_remedies: Brahmi, ashwagandha, ginkgo biloba. Emergency medical care critical
